payload.title: Calibration of the Sr/Ca paleothermometer: a frequentist approach
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the calibration of coral Sr/Ca measurements to sea surface temperature (SST) using a frequentist approach, specifically Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) and Weighted Least Squares (WLS) regression. The data used for calibration is sourced from DeLong et al. (2011) and involves coral samples from Dry Tortugas. The notebook imports necessary libraries, loads the data, performs regression analyses, and summarizes the results in tabular form. The outputs include regression parameters, standard errors, and R-squared values for different coral cores and SST datasets.
goals: Calibrate coral Sr/Ca measurements to sea surface temperature.
